column1: # Verdicts for the Equicord/Vencord plugins outside the 2026-09-21 backup: name, port|native|n/a, usefulness 1-5
# (ports only), what the user gets and how gravecord gives it / where it is native / why nothing applies.
# Read by tools/gen-plugins-md.py; a plugin moves to the PORTED table of the generator once it is built.

column4: While editing a message, a button adds more files to it; gravecord would offer an attach button in the inline message editor that uploads through its existing uploads path and edits the message with the new attachments. No settings. needs base: attachments editable in the message editor (editor.rs edits text only).

Collapses or expands the simplified permissions card in role permission editing; gravecord would give its role permissions page the same card/advanced toggle. Settings: simplifiedCard, collapsedByDefault. needs base: check app/src/ui/server_roles.rs for a simplified permissions card first; if absent there is nothing to collapse.
Clicking a user opens the full profile instead of the small popout; gravecord would route the popout open to its full profile view (ui/full_profile.rs) when the plugin is on. No settings.

The role list in profile views is always fully expanded instead of showing a "more" chip; gravecord would draw all role chips in profile and popout role rows. Setting: hideArrow (hides the collapse arrow).

Plays Animal Crossing style babble for each incoming message letter; gravecord would synthesize it through its sound output (sounds.rs) from the message text. Settings: volume, speed, pitch, messageLengthLimit, processOwnMessages, soundQuality.

Adds @someone, which mentions a random member of the server; gravecord would add it to the composer mention autocomplete and replace it with a random member mention on send (send_policy.rs). No settings.

Sets status to a chosen one (default do not disturb) while a game is running and restores it afterwards; gravecord already detects running games (games.rs, ui/running_games.rs) and owns its presence, so it would switch presence on game start and stop. Setting: statusToSet. Restores the previous status on exit.

When a desktop notification arrives for an unmuted channel, opens that channel automatically, by default only while the window is unfocused; gravecord would hook its desktop notification path (notifications/) and navigate to the channel. Setting: onlyWhenUnfocused.

Zips files with listed extensions (and dropped folders) before upload so Discord accepts them; gravecord would do it in uploads.rs using its existing store-only ZIP writer (plugins/zip.rs). Setting: extensions (comma separated list).

Shows profile banners behind members in the member list and DM list rows, optionally animated, preferring a nameplate if set; gravecord would draw the banner strip in those native rows. Settings: animate, preferNameplate, palette (data is cache).

Loads a bigger window of history when a channel opens, restores scroll to the last read message if it is recent, and shows the jump-to-present bar sooner; gravecord would raise the initial fetch and scroll window and the last-read jump in ui/jump.rs and ui/unread.rs. Settings: messageCount, useDiscordMessageCount, channelOpenScrollMode, maximumLastReadAge, showJumpToPresentSooner, messageLoadBuffer, imageScrollMargin (map to prefetch distances of the native list), addChatbarButton, clearSavedHistory.
Ban dialog gets your own saved reason presets and can default to a free text reason; gravecord would add this to its ban dialog (ui/member_actions.rs). Settings: reasons, isTextInputDefault.
GIF picker opens on Favorites instead of the trending page; gravecord would set the picker's initial tab (ui/gif_tiles.rs, plugins/gif_provider.rs). No settings.

Image attachment editor with a library of recent pictures, remembered crop and zoom, and optionally saving the cropped copy; gravecord would add crop and framing memory to its upload card image editor. Settings: librarySize, rememberCrop, forgetFraming, saveCropped, askBeforeSavingCropped. needs base: an image crop and edit step in the upload card (no crop surface found in app/src/ui/files.rs or uploads.rs).

Invite embeds show the expiry date, let you open the inviter's profile, and preview the server before joining; gravecord would add these to its invite card (ui/invite.rs, ui/accept_invite.rs). No settings.
Mutual servers list in a profile also shows your roles there and join dates; gravecord would add those lines to the mutual servers rows of ui/full_profile.rs. No settings.
Shows vote counts and percentages on a poll before you vote or before it ends, without blocking voting; gravecord would force the count display in ui/poll.rs. No settings.

Extra message search filters (channel scope options the stock UI hides); gravecord would expose them in its search filter row (ui/search.rs) and pass the matching query parameters. No settings. needs base: check search.rs filter list for the missing options.

Session list in settings gets names and richer info, plus a background check that notifies when a new login session appears; gravecord would add both to its Devices settings page and its notification path. Settings: backgroundCheck, checkInterval (minutes).

Hides messages containing listed words or regexes, optionally ignoring them completely; gravecord would filter the message list before drawing. Settings: blockedWords, useRegex, caseSensitive, ignoreBlockedMessages.
Stops the Krisp noise module from loading (privacy); gravecord has no Krisp module at all, the "Krisp" choice in voice settings is local DeepFilterNet, so there is nothing to block.

Blurs image and video attachments in NSFW channels (or all channels) until hovered; gravecord would blur those thumbnails in its attachment renderer. Settings: blurAmount, blurAllChannels, ignoredChannels.
Pin and unpin messages without the confirmation dialog; gravecord would skip its pin confirm modal (ui/modal.rs, ui/actions.rs). No settings.

Small badges on channels in the sidebar by type (voice, stage, forum, announcements, NSFW and so on); gravecord would draw them in its native channel list rows. Check the source for any per-type toggles before building.

Browser style tabs of favourite channels at the top of the chat, with context menu entries to pin or open in a tab; gravecord would draw a tab strip above the chat and store tabs in the local store. needs base: a tab strip surface (ui/keyboard has channel switching only). Setting: contextMenus.

Shows characters used against the limit under the composer, coloured as you near it; gravecord would draw the counter in its composer (limit from send_policy.rs, longer with Nitro). Setting: colorEffects.
Strips emoji and decoration from channel names in the sidebar, restoring the original while editing; gravecord would apply a name filter in channel list rows. Settings: ignoredChannels, contextMenus.
Hides all channels of a collapsed category even if they are unread; gravecord would drop the "unread channels stay visible" rule when a category is collapsed in the channel list. No settings.
Clicking a role chip in a profile or the member list shows the members that hold it; gravecord would open a members-with-role list from role chips (ui/server_roles.rs has role data). No settings.

Local blocking of listed users beyond Discord's block: hide their messages, replies, voice channels containing them and empty roles, with per-server allow or deny lists; gravecord would filter in the message list and rails. Settings: usersToBlock, hideBlockedUsers, hideBlockedMessages, hideVc, hideEmptyRoles, blockedReplyDisplay, guildBlackList, guildWhiteList.
Pick one colour that tints the whole client theme (the retired client theme experiment); gravecord would feed the colour into its own theme tokens. Settings: color, resetColor.

Buttons to collapse the channel list, member list, chat buttons and user area for more space; gravecord would add collapse toggles to its panes with the sizes kept in the store. needs base: collapsible panes (no member list collapse found in app/src/ui). Settings are the header bar button and chat bar wrapper toggles.

Raycast style command palette that runs actions anywhere: open settings, toggle plugins, switch status, go to channel; gravecord would extend its Ctrl+K quick switcher with an actions list. No settings listed except the key binding.
Silences Discord's console loggers and the Spotify logger that leaks a token into the devtools console; gravecord has no devtools console or JS loggers.
Adds short aliases on window for the devtools console (webpack finders and stores); a dev tool for the mod, gravecord has no JS window or console.
Blurs messages that contain your trigger words until hovered or clicked; gravecord would blur those message bodies in the renderer. Settings: flagged (word list), onClick.
Context menu on an emoji copies it as <:name:id> markdown, or the unicode character for default emoji; gravecord would add the entry to its emoji context menu. Settings: copyUnicode, contextMenus.
Text file attachments get a button that copies their contents; gravecord would add it to the attachment row, reading the cached file. No settings.
Context menu entry on a profile copies the gradient colours as hex; gravecord would add it to the profile context menu. Setting: contextMenus.
Right clicking a custom status that has a link copies the URL; gravecord would add this to the status context menu in profiles. No settings.
User context menu entry copies the <@id> mention; gravecord would add it to its user context menu (ui/context_menu.rs). Setting: contextMenus.

A little animal (oneko cat or fat horse) follows the mouse cursor across the window; gravecord would draw a sprite overlay following the pointer. Settings: buddy, speed, fps, size, fade, freeroam, shake, furColor, outlineColor.
Replace a server folder's icon with any PNG; gravecord would draw the picked image in the rail folder (ui/rail_folders.rs) and keep it in the local store. Setting: contextMenus.

Set the minutes before the account goes idle (0 disables it), and optionally stay idle on return until you confirm; gravecord's idle limit is a fixed 10 minutes (idle.rs IDLE_AFTER_MS), so the plugin would make it configurable. Settings: idleTimeout, remainInIdle.

Replace any of Discord's UI sounds with your own file, per sound, and pick a soundpack; gravecord already has soundpack tables and per-sound switches (sounds.rs) so it would add a file override per sound from its local sounds folder. Settings: soundpack, overrides (per sound name).

Adds extra durations (seconds, minutes, hours, days) to the custom status "clear after" menu and can put Forever on top; gravecord would extend that picker in the status editor. Settings: showForeverOnTop, extraSeconds, extraMinutes, extraHours, extraDays.
Define your own formats for message timestamps (today, yesterday, older, tooltips, relative); gravecord would format timestamps through the user pattern. Setting: formats (pattern per kind).

Give chosen users a local name colour, including in the DM list and optionally in servers; gravecord would store the colour per user id and apply it in name draws. Settings: dmList, colorInServers, contextMenus.

Replaces YouTube embed titles and thumbnails with community versions from the DeArrow API; gravecord would fetch through its network layer and swap them in video embeds (ui/embed.rs), with a toggle on each embed. Settings: hideButton, replaceElements, dearrowByDefault.

Hides profile and chrome clutter: avatar decorations, nameplates, profile effects and frames, clan tags, styled display names, the Shop/Quests/Library/Family Center rows above the DM list, boost info, gift button, unavailable emoji categories, audio menu arrows, button tooltips and account popout badges, orbs and invisible warning. gravecord draws each of these itself (avatar_play.rs, rail, home, account panel), so each switch just skips the element. Keys: removeAvatarDecoration, removeNameplate, removeProfileEffect, removeProfileFrame, removeClanTag, removeDisplayNameStyles, alwaysShowUsername, removeShopAboveDms, removeQuestsAboveDms, removeLibraryAboveDms, removeFamilyCenterAboveDms, removeServerBoostInfo, removeBillingSettings, removeGiftButton, removeUnavailableEmojiPicker, removeAudioMenus, removeButtonTooltips, removeAccountPopoutBadges, removeAccountPopoutOrbs, removeInvisibleWarning. The "disabled when Decor is on" rule has no meaning here.

Adds a message action that finds base64 strings in the message and shows the decoded text (valid UTF-8 only) in a dialog with a copy button per result. gravecord does it as a message hover or context-menu action opening a native dialog with code blocks. No settings. Needs base: none (message actions and dialogs exist).
Dev tool for the mod itself: a websocket (port 8485) to the Vencord Companion VS Code extension to extract, diff and test webpack modules and patches. gravecord has no webpack or patch system.

An attachment's Download item already saves straight into the Downloads folder without a browser: app/src/ui/file_actions.rs (download_attachment, attachment_downloaded toast), plus download_all.rs for DownloadAllAttachments.

Joining or accepting a call never turns your camera on by itself (the plugin forces self_video to false in the voice state). gravecord does the same where its call join/accept builds the voice state (dm_call.rs, net.rs). No settings. Needs base: none.

Shows the developer banner at the top of the window with build info. gravecord would draw its own thin banner with channel, pinned build number (1.0.9267), gravecord version and hash from the format template. Key: format (variables buildChannel, buildNumber, buildHash, equicordName, equicordVersion, equicordHash map to the gravecord equivalents). Needs base: a top banner slot (the pinned client shows this banner only on staging builds).

Relative times ("in 8y" style, <t:..:R>) floor instead of round, so 7.6y reads 7y. gravecord builds its own moment-style relative strings, so the port is the same floor in that formatter. No settings.

A dialog listing your unsent drafts (channel or DM name, location, preview up to 500 chars, newest first, searchable) that jumps to the channel on click. gravecord keeps drafts per channel (app/src/ui/drafts.rs, dc_state::draft), so the list is read from that store and a row opens the channel. No settings. Needs base: a list dialog opened from a header entry or shortcut.

Reorder your favourite emojis by dragging them in the Favorites category of the emoji picker, saved back to the favourite emoji list. gravecord has its own picker (emoji_popout.rs) and favourites; the port adds drag reorder in that category. No settings. Needs base: drag reorder inside the picker grid (channel_drag.rs and rail_folders.rs have drag code for other lists).

Drag a user, channel, DM or server onto the message box to insert a mention, ID or invite link. gravecord adds drag sources on member rows, channel list, DM list and server rail and a drop target on the composer. Keys: userOutput, channelOutput, inviteExpireAfter, inviteMaxUses, inviteTemporaryMembership, reuseExistingInvites, allowChatBodyDrop. Needs base: a composer/chat-body drop target for in-app drags (channel_drag.rs only reorders channels).

Category context menu gets Duplicate Category: a dialog with a prefilled name and a Copy permissions check, then creates the category with the same permission overwrites. gravecord has category menus and create_channel.rs, so it is a menu item plus a small dialog. No settings. Needs base: none.
Dev tool: highlights the hovered DOM element and shows its CSS classes, id, font, padding, margin, border radius, position and display. gravecord has no DOM or CSS.

Screen share quality: unlock every resolution and fps option without Nitro, remove the 720p60 cap, force the encoder to the chosen size and fps, stop downscaling and framerate reduction, set keyframe interval and a minimum bitrate. gravecord owns its capture and encode path (dc-voice, Go Live), so each key sets the encoder parameters directly and the picker shows every option. Keys: unlockQualityOptions, removeResolutionCap, forceEncoderSettings, preventDownscale, keyframeInterval, minBitrate, raiseBitrateCaps, preventFramerateReduction, bitsPerPixelPct. Needs base: check that the stream settings UI and encoder accept values above the Nitro tiers (StreamingCodecDisabler and BiggerStreamPreview touch the same area).

A header-bar button opening a menu of every plugin's quick actions plus an optional plugin on/off list. gravecord has a plugins settings page with switches; the port is a header-bar popout with the same quick actions and the switch list. Key: showPluginMenu. Needs base: a header-bar button slot and a quick-action list in the plugin registry.

Plays a croissant sound every N clicks anywhere in the window. gravecord counts window clicks and plays the sound through sounds.rs. Key: amount (default 10). Needs base: none; the sound file must be fetched or shipped.

Bundle of small fixes. Worth carrying: noMirroredCamera (camera preview not mirrored), removeActivitySection, showYourOwnActivityButtons, refreshSlashCommands (BetterCommands already has /refresh), forceRoleIcon in compact mode, accountStandingButton in the header bar, restoreFileDownloadButton, noBulletPoints, noModalAnimation, disableAdoptTagPrompt, disableHolidayNotifications (default sound pack, sounds/table.rs has the holiday ones), hideVoiceIndicatorForMutedChannels, noOnboarding, removeChannelSuggestions, showAllBadges, gifPickerTyping, enableAutoCorrect and autoCorrect (gravecord has spellcheck.rs). Dropped: jsonGateway (gravecord's gateway layer is its own). Needs base: a header-bar button for accountStandingButton.

When you leave a voice channel a soundboard sound plays for everyone in it (skipped while deafened). gravecord has the soundboard and the voice disconnect path (call_menus.rs, net.rs); the sound is chosen with a server picker and a sound id field plus a Set as global exit sound item in the soundboard sound menu. Keys: soundGuildId, soundId. Needs base: none.

Message context menu item that saves one message as a text file (timestamp, author, content, attachment links, embed titles and URLs) and opens it; optional friends-tab button that copies your friend list. gravecord writes the file to Downloads as file_actions.rs does. Keys: openFileAfterExport, exportContacts. Needs base: none.
Dev tool: runs a debugger statement when F8 is pressed with DevTools open. gravecord has no Chrome devtools.

Without Nitro you can still use custom emojis and stickers anywhere: they are sent as image links (sized, optionally as hyperlinks with a label, optionally without the embed permission check) and shown back as the real emoji or sticker; stream quality bypass too. gravecord has the send path (send_policy.rs) and renderers (emoji_popout.rs, stickers.rs), so it rewrites the outgoing text and the link rendering. Keys: enableEmojiBypass, emojiSize, transformEmojis, enableStickerBypass, stickerSize, transformStickers, transformCompoundSentence, enableStreamQualityBypass, useStickerHyperLinks, useEmojiHyperLinks, hyperLinkText, disableEmbedPermissionCheck. Needs base: the emoji and sticker pickers must stop locking those items while the plugin is on (NoNitroUpsell exists).

Profile theme colours hidden in the bio with invisible characters: you pick two colours and anyone with the plugin sees your profile themed even without Nitro; other people's encoded colours are decoded and applied. gravecord draws profiles itself (full_profile.rs, profile_editor), so it decodes the bio and applies the colours when the profile has no theme. Key: nitroFirst. Needs base: a colour picker in the profile editor and a theme colour override in the profile renderer.

A trash mode for the channel list: a key combo toggles it and every channel row shows a trash icon that deletes without the dialog. gravecord has channel delete (channel_settings.rs) and keyboard.rs. Keys: keyBind, reqCtrl, reqShift, reqAlt. Needs base: none.

Favourite any image, video or file attachment and see them in a favourites tab of the expression picker, not just GIFs. gravecord has GIF favourites (gifs.rs, favorites.rs); the port keeps attachment favourites in the local data store and shows them in a new picker category with locally made thumbnails. Key: localThumbnails (gravecord makes thumbnails locally anyway, so it can be fixed on). Needs base: a non-GIF favourites category in the picker.

Upload files to your own host (Zipline, Nest, S3, WebDAV, Catbox, Litterbox, Gofile, ShareX configs) and post the link, also automatically for files over Discord's size limit. gravecord has an upload flow (upload_flow.rs, plugins/clip_upload.rs as a model), so the port adds service adapters through net.rs and a pre-send hook; tokens stay in the secret store. Keys: serviceType, serviceUrl, ziplineToken, ziplineStripExtension, ziplineOriginalName, folderId, ezHostKey, nestToken, encryptingHost* keys, litterboxExpiry, catboxUserhash, sharexConfig, disableFallbacks, autoSend, autoFormat, bypassDiscordUpload, bypassDiscordUploadOnlyOverLimit, customDiscordFileSizeLimitMB, gofileToken, fallbackOrder, pixelVaultKey, pixelDrainKey, uploadTimeoutMs, stripQueryParams, embedProxyEnabled, embedProxyService, apngToGif, autoCopy, autoUploadPastedFiles, webdav* keys, uploadAllowedFileTypes. corsProxyUrl is dropped (no CORS in a native client). Needs base: a plugin hook in the upload card flow.

Message action that jumps to the earliest reply to a message in the channel, with a bar to step through replies; hidden when there are none. gravecord has jump-to-message and reply references, so it scans loaded and fetched messages. Keys: includePings, includeAuthor, hideButtonIfNoReply. Needs base: a floating reply navigator bar.

Removes the blank gap between a fenced code block and the text right after it by letting the block rule swallow one trailing newline. gravecord renders markdown itself (dc-markdown), so the port is that one rule in the parser behind the plugin switch. No settings.
Web-only: deletes a CSS rule (:has(.gameOption_)) that makes the browser style engine lag. gravecord has no CSS. Required (always on) in Vencord.

Uploaded files with extensions Discord cannot preview are renamed to a supported one (.avi to .mp4, .bmp to .jpg, .aiff to .m4a, .ico to .png and so on) so they play or show inline. gravecord renames at send time in uploads.rs (as AnonymiseFileNames does), so the port adds the extension map and yields to AnonymiseFileNames as the original does. No settings.

Spotify embeds play at a chosen volume instead of full volume. gravecord already draws the official Spotify player in a web view (ui/web_frames.rs); the port sets the volume in that page. Key: volume (0 to 100, default 10). Needs base: running script in a web frame (dc-webhost has no eval or inject call yet).

Right-click a friend and tick Follow User: whenever they move to another voice channel you join it too, optionally leaving when they leave, optionally only while you are in voice. gravecord has the voice state events and the join path; the item goes in the user menu for friends. Keys: onlyWhenInVoice, leaveWhenUserLeaves. Needs base: none.

Pick any Google Font for the whole client and optionally for code blocks. gravecord loads gg sans from the official asset host (app/src/fonts.rs); the port downloads the chosen font into the same on-disk cache and uses it as the UI font. Keys: selectedFont, fontSearch (search field in the plugin settings), applyOnCodeBlocks. Needs base: a user font override in the text layer; fonts.rs only knows the pinned faces.

The quick switcher lists your most used channels first (by use count) filtered by the query, instead of its normal ranking. gravecord has the switcher (quickswitcher.rs) and frecency data (dc_state::frecency), so the port swaps the ranking. No settings. Needs base: none.

A panel on the Add Friend tab to generate friend codes (a short code others paste to send you a request) and list or revoke yours. gravecord has friend invites (plugin_commands.rs) and friends.rs; the port adds the panel on the same endpoints. No settings. Needs base: a panel slot in the Add Friend view.

Shows a rank (Sprout, Blooming, Burning, Fighter, Star, Royal, Besties at 0/30/90/182/365/730/1826 days of friendship) on a friend's profile, optionally a friend icon on their messages; clicking opens a rank dialog. gravecord has the friend-since date in profiles (full_profile.rs); rank icons are fetched or drawn natively. Key: showFriendsInChat. Needs base: none.

Name groups of friends as tags (set from the user context menu), then start a quick switcher search with & and a tag name to list those people. gravecord keeps the tags in its local data store and adds the tag filter to quickswitcher.rs. Key: tagConfiguration (tag editor in the plugin settings). Needs base: none.

Marks DMs where the other person has not answered your last message: a ghost counter above the server list, ghost icons on DM rows and a dialog listing them. gravecord has the DM list and message store; the port adds the markers. Keys: showIndicator, showDmIcons, ignoreGroupDms, exemptedChannels, ignoreBots, maxInactiveTimeMs. Needs base: a slot above the server rail.

Create named collections of GIFs and browse them as categories in the GIF picker, adding from the GIF context menu. gravecord has its own GIF picker (ui/gifs.rs, gif_tiles.rs) and a local data store, so collections are stored locally and shown as extra categories. Needs base: user categories in the picker's category row.

User profiles show the user's public GitHub repositories (from their connected GitHub account) as a section with name, description, stars and language. gravecord has connections (ShowConnections) and profile sections; the port fetches the GitHub API through net.rs. Keys: showStars, showLanguage. Needs base: an extra section in the profile renderer.

A /google style command that sends a search link for your query to the chat. gravecord has client-side plugin commands (plugin_hooks/plugin_commands.rs), so it is one more entry in that table. Keys: hyperlink, embed, defaultEngine, customEngineURL. Needs base: none.

Server context menu entry that downloads every emoji and sticker of the server as files in a zip. gravecord has emoji and sticker lists (server_emoji.rs, server_stickers.rs) and a zip writer (plugins/zip.rs). No settings. Needs base: none.

Collapses the composer's button strip (gift, GIF, sticker, emoji, plugin buttons) behind one toggle button. gravecord draws the composer buttons itself (composer_plus.rs); the port adds the toggle. Keys: color (tint the toggle red when open), open (opened by default). Needs base: none.

Hover button on a message that hides its attachments and embeds, and shows them again, for that message only. gravecord renders attachments and embeds itself (embed.rs already has a hide-media path for the media setting), so a per-message flag feeds it. No settings. Needs base: none.

Hide a message or a whole DM until the client restarts, from the message hover bar or context menu. gravecord keeps the set in memory and skips those rows and DM list entries. Key: hidePopoverButton. Needs base: none.

Right-click a server to hide it from the server rail and the quick switcher, with a list in settings to unhide. gravecord has the rail and its menus (rail_folders.rs, rail_folder_menu.rs); hidden ids live in the local data store. No settings. Needs base: none.

The Home button in the server rail becomes a typing indicator when someone in your DMs is typing. gravecord already tracks typing per channel (typing_users, TypingIndicator), so the rail button swaps its icon. No settings. Needs base: none.

When a message in the open channel matches a regex, a URL opens in the browser (for example a game server link). gravecord opens the URL through its link opener on matching incoming messages. Keys: regex, url. Needs base: none.

Adds a husk emoji button to the message hover bar that sends or reacts with the configured emoji (looks it up by name in the current server first when you lack Nitro). gravecord adds the hover bar button and uses its emoji data. Keys: findInServer, emojiName, emojiID. Needs base: none.
Dev tool: a settings tab that previews Discord's web icon components found through webpack. gravecord draws its own icons natively and has no component registry.

After N idle minutes with no voice call the app restarts itself. gravecord relaunches through its updater or relaunch path using idle.rs for the idle measure, which also lets a staged update install. Keys: isEnabled, idleMinutes. Needs base: none.

Ignore incoming calls from chosen users or DM groups: a context menu toggle plus a list of permanently ignored ids; the ring and popup are skipped. gravecord has incoming call handling (dm_call.rs, call_popout.rs), so the check goes before the ring. Key: permanentlyIgnoredUsers. Needs base: none.
Hovering an image or GIF in a message shows its file name (the full URL for tenor/giphy/imgur GIFs) as a tooltip, drawn natively on the media row's hover. Settings: showFullUrl.

A message that is only an image link keeps its link text visible above the image instead of the link being hidden; gravecord does it in the message content renderer by skipping its hide-link-only-message rule. No settings.

Adds an implicit relationships list (people you talk to but are not friends with) to the Friends tab, fetched from the user affinities endpoint and sorted by communication rank. Settings: sortByAffinity. Needs base: affinities fetch in dc_http and a Friends tab section (ui/friends.rs only ignores relationship type 5 today).

A joke: adds "ington" to a random word of an outgoing message, with a composer toggle button. Gravecord would use its send policy hook (send_policy.rs) on the outgoing text. Settings: showIcon, isEnabled. Needs base: a composer button slot for plugins.

Lists the members who have a role: a "who is in this role" item on the role context menu and an /inrole command, from the member list already loaded (offline members are missing unless loaded, as upstream says). Needs base: plugin slash command and a role context menu entry.

Joining a voice channel starts a Go Live stream at once from a chosen screen, window or camera, with optional auto mute or deafen and a keybind to toggle, through gravecord's own Go Live start (ui/go_live_game.rs, voice engine capture sources). Settings: streamMedia, includeVideoDevices, autoMute, autoDeafen, instantScreenshare, keybindScreenshare, focusDiscord. Needs base: starting a stream without the picker modal and a capture source list lookup.

Hides a message inside zero-width characters under a cover text with an optional password, and decrypts such messages in the chat with a lock indicator; the encoding is plain string work done in the composer and message renderer. Settings: savedPasswords, chatBarButton, messagePopoverButton. Needs base: composer button slot and a message content transform hook.

The Create Invite dialog opens with your preferred expiry, max uses and temporary membership instead of Discord's defaults; gravecord would seed ui/invite.rs from the setting. Settings: inviteDuration, maxUses, temporaryMembership.

Colors every username by a hash of its ID (hue from the hash, fixed saturation and lightness) like IRC clients, in messages and optionally the member list, for everyone, only users without a role color, or only in DMs. Gravecord replaces the name color at its role_color draw sites (ui.rs). Settings: lightness, saturation, seed, memberListColors, applyColorOnlyToUsersWithoutColor, applyColorOnlyInDms.

Keeps a local backup list of everyone you talked to and your servers' owners and members (id, name, avatar) so you can still find them after losing an account, shown on a plugin settings page. Gravecord keeps it in its local data store and plugin settings page. Needs base: a message-send listener for plugins.

Adds Jump to Start and Jump to Bottom to the channel and DM context menus, using gravecord's jump loader (ui/jump.rs, which already loads a page around a message and jumps to present). No settings. Needs base: a fetch of the channel's first messages for Jump to Start.
A button that jumps to the first message of the channel, through ui/jump.rs. Needs base: a "first message" fetch (oldest page) since jump.rs only jumps to a given message or to present.

On start or after an account switch, reopens the channel you last had open instead of Home; gravecord stores the last channel per account in its local data store and routes to it at login (ui/start_cache.rs and deep_link_route.rs already carry start routing). No settings.

A command palette on its own hotkey (setting hotkey, allowMouseControl) that runs actions and goes anywhere by keyboard; gravecord has the Ctrl+K quick switcher (ui/quickswitcher.rs) for places but no list of actions, so the port is a palette of the app's actions beside it.

Plays a keypress sound while you type in the composer, OperaGX or osu! packs, through gravecord's own sound output (sounds.rs); gravecord would bundle the samples. Settings: volume, soundPack. Needs base: a keystroke hook in the composer (editor.rs).

Context menu entries to jump to your last message, or another user's last message, in a channel or server, using message search and gravecord's jump loader (ui/jump.rs). Needs base: search-by-author from a user context menu.

Replaces the quotes the client shows while it loads (its own set, custom quotes with a delimiter, Discord's event quotes). needs base: gravecord's start screen (spinner.rs) shows no loading quote yet; port the pinned client's quotes there first, then the plugin's choices.

Scan a login QR code to sign another device in: a Scan QR Code entry in settings that takes an image or clipboard picture, decodes the remote-auth fingerprint and approves the login with the account's own session. Gravecord only draws a stand-in QR on the Add Account dialog (ui/account_switcher.rs). Needs base: QR decode from an image and the remote-auth confirm REST calls in dc_http.

Renders GitHub style pipe tables in messages as a real table with a Table/Raw toggle, in gravecord's own markup renderer (markup_preview.rs, inline.rs). Settings: hideToggle. Needs base: a table layout node in the markdown renderer.

Sets the default playback speed of voice messages, videos and audio attachments and adds a speed button on their players; gravecord applies it in ui/audio_attachment.rs and the video player. Settings: defaultVoiceMessageSpeed, defaultVideoSpeed, defaultAudioSpeed.
Shows the user's avatar (or role icon) inside mention pills in messages; gravecord draws it in the mention chip of the message renderer. Settings: showAtSymbol.

Merges your new message into your previous one when sent within a time window and nobody posted in between, by editing the previous message through the API, in gravecord's send path (send_policy.rs). Settings: timePeriod, shouldMergeWithAttachment, useSpace.
Message text that looks like a hex color (#FF0042) gets a color swatch or colored text, drawn in the markdown renderer. Settings: renderType, enableShortHexCodes, blockView.

Shows how long the channel's message fetch took as a clock icon with tooltip in the message bar, measured at gravecord's own fetch (net.rs). Settings: showIcon, showMs, iconColor. Needs base: timing of the message page request, which net.rs does not record.

Marks messages whose send-to-arrival gap (timestamp vs snowflake time) exceeds a threshold with a small indicator; plain arithmetic in the message header. Settings: latency, detectDiscordKotlin, showMillis, ignoreSelf.

A link to another message (discord.com/channels/...) shows a preview of that message under it, from the cache or the API with the permission check; settings pick rich vs automod style and a user/guild/channel list. Settings: messageBackgroundColor, automodEmbeds, listMode, idList. Needs base: a message fetch by id usable by plugins in net.rs.

Hovering a message link, a reply preview or a forwarded message pops a tooltip with the target message content; gravecord draws it on hover using the same message fetch. Settings: onLink, onReply, onForward, display.

Raises a toast when chosen users send a message anywhere, using gravecord's desktop notifications (notifications.rs). Settings: users (comma separated IDs). Needs base: a plugin hook on incoming messages.

Translates incoming messages to your language automatically, cached, with per-channel toggles; the translation engine exists for Translate+ (plugins/translate_plus.rs, Request::PluginTranslate), so the port adds the automatic pass, the cache and the per-channel switches.

A mic icon in the account panel that plays your microphone back to you to test it, through gravecord's voice engine; Voice settings already has a mic test (ui/settings/voice.rs), so this is a quick toggle in the user panel. Needs base: a plugin button slot in the user panel (ui/voice_panel.rs) and a monitor path to the output device outside a call.

Adds sticker packs from other services (LINE) to the sticker picker and sends them as images or links; gravecord would add a pack source to its sticker picker. Settings: sendDirectly, packs. Needs base: a plugin pack source in the sticker picker and sending a picked image as an upload.

Adds tags next to names in chat for webhooks, owner, admin, moderator and staff by permissions, in the message header chip row (ui.rs, message_header). Settings: dontShowForBots, dontShowBotTag, showWebhookTagFully, noAppsAllowed, tagSettings.

Plays a moai sound when the emoji is sent, reacted or used as a voice effect in the current channel, with volume and unfocused options, through sounds.rs. Settings: volume, quality, triggerWhenUnfocused, ignoreBots, ignoreBlocked.

A music player bar in the account panel for Spotify (and Tidal over a local websocket) with lyrics: gravecord has a Spotify dealer reader (spotify.rs), so Spotify controls and lyrics port with its own player widget. Settings: hoverControls, showMusicNoteOnNoLyrics, lyricsPosition, translateTo, lyricsConversion, showFailedToasts, lyricDelay, showSpotifyControls, showSpotifyLyrics, useSpotifyUris, previousButtonRestartsTrack, showTidalControls, showTidalLyrics, websocketURL. Needs base: a lyrics source and a player widget in the user panel.

Sets your Discord activity to the track you are listening to, from Last.fm or a ListenBrainz scrobbler, through gravecord's own presence update path (plugins/custom_rpc.rs). Settings: scrobbler backend, ListenBrainz URLs, Last.fm API key, username, show profile link, clickable names, hide while Spotify runs.
Keeps the unread badge of a muted server on the server rail instead of hiding it, in gravecord's server list drawing (ui.rs). No settings.

Profiles get a Mutual Groups list of group DMs you share with that user, computed from gravecord's own DM channel list (ui/dm_profile.rs and full_profile.rs already carry mutual friends and servers). No settings.
Stops the web client from pausing in-call stream previews when the window loses focus; gravecord's native stream tiles have no visibility-based pause, so there is nothing to prevent.

After an update, tells you which plugins are new in this version (and marks them in the plugin list); gravecord's plugins ship with the app, so the port compares the registry against the last version seen and shows the new ones.

Removes blocked and ignored users' messages entirely instead of the collapsed "blocked message" row, with replies and notifications optional and an override list. Gravecord's ui/blocked.rs draws the collapsed rows; the plugin hides them. Settings: alsoHideIgnoredUsers, disableNotifications, allowAutoModMessages, hideBlockedUserReplies, defaultHideUsers, overrideUsers.
Stops F1 from opening Discord's help page; gravecord's keyboard table (ui/keyboard.rs) would drop that binding. No settings.
Pasting a link over selected text pastes the plain link instead of making a masked link; gravecord does it in the composer paste handler (editor.rs). No settings.
Disables the Linux-only middle-click paste of the primary selection; gravecord is a Windows client where middle click does not paste, so there is nothing to disable.

Shows each attached image at full size in a column instead of the mosaic grid, and optionally plays video inline instead of in the carousel; gravecord changes the ui/mosaic.rs layout. Settings: inlineVideo.
The server onboarding screen holds Next for 3 seconds; the plugin removes the wait, in ui/member_onboarding.rs. No settings.
Ignores other users' Nitro profile theme colors and draws their profiles with the normal theme, in ui/full_profile.rs and dm_profile.rs; your own stays. No settings.

Replies do not ping the author by default (allowed_mentions replied_user false), with user and role lists and an inverted shift behaviour; gravecord sets it at the reply send in net.rs. Settings: userList, roleList, shouldPingListed, inverseShiftReply.
The member list shows members in one flat online/offline list without role group headers; gravecord changes the member list grouping in ui.rs. No settings.
Stops the local Discord RPC server so games and apps cannot connect to it, through a switch that keeps gravecord's own RPC server (rpc.rs, dc-rpc) from starting. No settings.

Hides server emojis from the emoji autocomplete, setting shownEmojis (only unicode / plus current server / all). gravecord filters its own autocomplete list by the setting; the editor autocomplete is native, no base needed.
Switch to turn off the taskbar and tray unread count badge. gravecord draws its own badge in app/src/notifications/taskbar.rs, so the plugin is a toggle that skips that update.

Makes desktop notifications more informative (channel, server and author in the title, cleaner body). gravecord builds its own notifications in app/src/notifications.rs, so the plugin changes the title and body formatting there; no settings in the source.

Separate volume slider (notificationVolume, 0-100, default 100) for notification sounds versus in-app sounds. gravecord has its own audio engine, so the port scales the notification sound gain; needs base: no per-sound-class volume exists in app/src today.

Pure websocket bridge (setting port, 6888) that streams Discord voice and message state to the external Orbolay overlay app; the user gets nothing without that third-party app, and gravecord has its own native state and overlay path.

Sets the default forum layout (list/grid) and sort order (recently active/creation date) used when a forum is opened without a per-channel choice. gravecord has forums in app/src/ui/forums.rs, so the port seeds those two values; keys defaultLayout, defaultSortOrder.
Visual shake and colour effect for fun, setting superIntensePartyMode (Normal/Better/Project X). gravecord can run a native animation on the window; cosmetic only.

Adds back the indefinite option when pausing server invites, which Discord removed from the official client. gravecord has its own invite pause UI in the server settings pages, so the port adds the option that sets the pause with no end time.

/petpet slash command that makes a headpat gif from an attachment, URL or user avatar; options delay, resolution, noServerPfp. gravecord has plugin_commands.rs and its own image code, so it renders the gif natively and uploads it.

Button on video attachments to pop the video into a small always-on-top window, setting loop. gravecord plays video natively, so it opens a second small window with the same player; needs base: a floating always-on-top video window.

Extra desktop notifications for mentions, DMs and friends talking in servers, settings friends, mentions, dms, showInActive, ignoreMuted. gravecord has plugin_notifications.rs and notifications.rs to hook and has the mute state natively.
Shows a pin icon on pinned messages in the chat. gravecord draws its own message rows, so the port adds the icon to the message header when the message id is in the channel pins list.
Server folders show a plain folder icon instead of the grid of small server icons. gravecord draws folders in app/src/ui/rail_folders.rs, so the port is a draw-mode switch there.

Fixes outgoing messages: capitalizes sentences, adds punctuation, fixes or expands apostrophes; settings quickDisable, blockedWords, fixApostrophes, expandContractions, fixCapitalization, fixPunctuation. gravecord applies it to the text in the send path of the editor.
Internal API so other plugins can add collection sections to the profile panel; nothing user-visible by itself. Ports that need such a section add it in their own code.

Save and load profile presets (avatar, banner, name, bio, pronouns, colours) from a list; setting avatarSize. gravecord has a native profile editor (app/src/ui/profile_editor), so presets are a local store plus a list there; needs base: preset store.

Quest controls: hide quest promos and the Quests surfaces, optionally auto-complete quests. gravecord has no Quests page today (only deep_link and games references), so the user mostly gets the hide side and the rest needs base: a Quests page; no top-level settings in the source, keep the context menu toggles.

Keyboard shortcut to cycle through installed themes; settings includeLocal, includeOnline, sortOrder, autoRefresh, showNotifications. gravecord has its own theme tokens and a theme list, so the port cycles those; online themes map to downloaded theme files.

Button and keybind to join a random voice channel filtered by user count and free spaces (UserAmount, UserAmountOperation, spacesLeft, keybind, keybindEnabled). gravecord has a native voice engine and channel list, so it picks from the joinable voice channels and joins.

Shows when each reaction was added in the reaction user list. gravecord has who_reacted.rs; needs base: the reactions endpoint gives no times, so it only works for reactions seen live through the gateway.

Cycle through recent DMs with a keybind and an Alt+Tab style overlay; settings visualStyle, overlayMode, amountOfUsers, overlayRowLength, overlayShowAvatars, toastDurationMs. gravecord draws the overlay natively on its keyboard layer.

Brings back the Remix button on images to edit and send a remix (drawing, stickers, text) from the image context menu. gravecord has its own image viewer and context menu; needs base: an image markup editor.
Repeat option in the message menu and hover button that resends the same message; shift-click replies instead; setting allowedMentions. gravecord adds it to its message context menu and send path.

The search-with-Google entry for selected text uses another engine (DuckDuckGo, Bing, custom); settings customEngineName, customEngineURL, replacementEngine. gravecord has a context menu in app/src/ui/context_menu.rs, so the port adds a search entry with the chosen engine.

Always or never get pinged on replies, with user id whitelist and blacklist; settings alwaysPingOnReply, replyPingWhitelist, replyPingBlacklist. gravecord applies it when building the reply mention flag in the editor.
Shows the replied-to message timestamp on the reply preview line. gravecord draws its own reply preview, so the port adds the time text there.

Third-party user reviews on profiles through the ReviewDB service, with context menu and new-review notice. gravecord would add a Reviews section to its full profile and call the service API; needs base: extra profile section hook, and it sends user ids to a third party.
Renders magnet: links as a card with name and trackers instead of raw text. gravecord draws its own message content, so it parses the magnet URI and shows a native card.

Rich presence from AudioBookShelf, osu!, stats.fm, Jellyfin, Plex, Navidrome and Gensokyo Radio set as the user's activity. gravecord has custom_rpc.rs and activity hooks, so each source is a provider feeding the existing RPC; keep each source's settings keys.

Edits type, name, details and images of any rich presence and replaces app ids; setting replacedAppIds. gravecord has custom_rpc.rs for its own RPC, so the port applies the overrides to the activity before it is sent.

Exports favorite GIF URLs to a text file, optionally testing which still work; setting showToolboxButton. gravecord has gif_provider.rs and the favorites list, so it writes the file with the native save dialog.

Schedule a message for a time or after a delay, with chat bar button, list and phantom message; settings maxMessagesPerMinute, checkIntervalSeconds, showNotifications, showPhantomMessages. gravecord has a local data store and its own timers, so it keeps the queue locally and sends while the app is open.

Record the screen and upload the recording to the channel. gravecord has clip_upload.rs and its own capture, so the port is a record button in the chat bar feeding the same upload; needs base: screen capture to a file.
Always plays the secret ringtone variant for calls; setting onlySnow. gravecord has its own call sounds, so it is a choice of ringtone file; needs base: the secret ringtone asset.

Picker to make Project Sekai character stickers with text and send them as images; setting AutoCloseModal. gravecord renders the image natively with bundled assets; needs base: sticker image assets and a chat bar button.

Chat bar button and text shortcuts to insert Discord timestamps with a format choice; setting replaceMessageContents. gravecord has its own editor and date picker, so it adds the button and the replace-on-send.
Quick search button on the server list to jump to a server by name. gravecord already has a quick switcher in the editor, so the port adds a rail button that opens it.

VS Code style syntax highlighting with themes in message code blocks. gravecord has a highlighter in editor.rs and markup_preview.rs; the port gives chat code blocks more grammars and themes through the native highlighter, no Shiki or web view.

Always show all message action buttons without holding shift; settings noShiftDelete, noShiftPin, noQuickReacts. gravecord draws its own message hover bar, so the port shows the full entries and drops the shift requirement.
Shows the author's profile badges next to the name in chat. gravecord has global_badges.rs for the data, so it renders the badges in the message header.

Lists channels you cannot view with a lock icon and shows their info; settings channelStyle, showMode. gravecord reads channels from the gateway guild payload, so it keeps the hidden ones in the list as locked; needs base: the channel list currently drops channels without view permission.
Context menu option to show an embed for a link that has none. gravecord has its own embed code (app/src/ui/embed.rs), so it fetches the metadata and draws a card locally.

Custom name format (nickname, username, display name) in messages, replies, mentions, typing indicator, member list and more; settings per place (messages, replies, mentions, typingIndicator, memberList). gravecord renders all those names itself, so one name formatter is applied in each place.
Shows the channels hidden behind the server Resources entry in the channel list. gravecord draws its own channel list, so it lists them directly.
Shows the author's highest role next to the name in messages, hide per role from a context menu; settings showBots, useRoleColor. gravecord has role_color_everywhere.rs for the role data to build on.
Spotify activity shows the song name instead of the artist on the activity line. gravecord draws its own activity rows (better_activities.rs), so it picks the field.

Shows how long a timed-out user stays timed out, inline or in the tooltip; setting displayStyle. gravecord draws the timeout icon itself, so it adds the remaining time from the communication_disabled_until field.
Open a channel or DM in a side panel or popout next to the current chat. gravecord has call_popout windows; needs base: a second chat view panel, which does not exist yet.
Appends a signature line to the end of your messages with a chat bar toggle; settings name, textHeader, showIcon, contextMenu, isEnabled. gravecord applies it in the send path of the editor.

Silences @mention pings and server unread badges from chosen users while keeping normal messages and DMs; setting mutedUserIds. gravecord applies it in its unread and mention counting and notifications.

Stops gravecord sending the typing event so others never see "is typing"; a composer button/menu toggles it, default hidden per setting. Carry over enabledGlobally, defaultHidden, alwaysEnableInActiveVoiceChat, chatIcon actions; hideChatBoxTypingIndicators, hideMembersListTypingIndicators and hideDmListTypingIndicators hide the incoming indicators in those surfaces. Hooks the typing send in net.rs/editor.rs and the chat typing line (typing_indicator.rs already exists for the channel list).

Falling snow drawn over the window with gpui paint, no DOM canvas. Settings typeOfSnow, maxSize, speed, flakesPerSecond; must be cheap and stop when the window is unfocused. Needs base: a full-window decorative overlay layer drawn above the content that does not take input.

Under a message that links Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal and similar, a row of service buttons (resolved through the song.link API) opens the same song in the other services. Carry over servicesSettings, userCountry, includeMetadata. Needs base: a per-message extra row under link embeds (check how embed.rs lets plugins add rows).

Adds a Song Spotlight section to the full profile showing songs a user picked, from the plugin's own web service (sign-in through Discord authorization), plus a chooser in your own profile settings. Needs base: a plugin-owned profile collection section in full_profile.rs; depends on a third-party service, so only worth it while that service is alive.

Sorts the pending friend request list by date received and shows the date on each row in the Friends pending tab. Setting showDates. The request timestamp is in the relationship data already read for the list.

A message over the length limit is cut into several sends (on a sentence or word boundary, or hard) instead of being refused, with a delay between chunks. Carry over sendDelay, splitMode, splitInSlowmode, slowmodeMax. Hooks the send path in send_policy.rs which already knows the limit and slowmode.

A Startup Timings page in settings listing how long the client took to start; gravecord would list its own phase timings (app start, gateway ready, first frame). Developer curiosity only. Needs base: a plugin-owned settings page entry in the Gravecord settings group (mods.rs).

Save the current custom status (text, emoji, expiry, status) as presets and apply one from a menu on the account panel status menu. Carry over StatusPresets (the saved list). The status menu and custom status editing already exist; the presets live in the plugin store.

Switches your online status to a chosen one (default Do Not Disturb) while you are in a voice channel and restores the previous status on leaving. Carry over statusToSet. Hooks voice join and leave in voice.rs and the existing status setter.

Hides stickers from chosen packs or all stickers in messages, replacing them with a small notice or cat gif; a context menu entry blocks a sticker pack. Carry over showGif, showMessage, showButton, blockedStickers. Hooks the sticker message renderer.

Choosing a sticker in the sticker picker puts it into the composer as a pending sticker instead of sending at once, so text can go with it. Hooks the picker pick action and the composer; needs base: a composer slot for a pending sticker (check composer_*.rs).

Turns streamer mode on when you start a Go Live stream and restores it when the stream ends. gravecord has the StreamerModeStore autoToggle (detection of streaming software, notifications.rs) but no trigger from its own stream; hook the stream start and stop in go_live.rs to the same enabled switch.
Client-mod plumbing: adds data attributes and CSS class props to Discord layout surfaces so themes can target them; gravecord has no DOM or CSS to style.
Composer button that reverses the message text before sending (a joke tool). A composer bar toggle plus a pre-send transform in send_policy.rs. Setting chatBarButton.

Replaces typed text on send using user rules (plain and regex); settings stringRules and regexRules edited in the plugin settings page, applied in the pre-send transform. Needs base: a list-of-pairs editor control in the plugin settings page.
Browses and installs community CSS themes from a web library. gravecord has no CSS injection; its own theme tokens and custom themes (client_theme.rs, custom_theme.rs) cannot take CSS themes.

A TIDAL link in a message gets an inline card like Spotify's. gravecord draws its own embed cards; give the link a card with cover, title and an open button since there is no iframe player. Needs base: an embed card for links Discord does not unfurl (embed.rs).

Shows a person's local time in the profile, in message headers and in DM headers, from a timezone database or your own override. Carry over showOwnTimezone, twentyFourHourFormat, showMessageHeaderTime, recipientTimezoneInDms, showProfileTime, useDatabase, preferDatabaseOverLocal, databaseUrl, setDatabaseTimezone; add a user menu entry to set a timezone locally. The community database is a third-party service; local per-user overrides work without it.
Changes the window title prefix from Discord to your own text (taskbar and alt-tab show it). Setting title. gravecord sets the title in ui.rs; read the plugin value there.

Shows in-app pop-up toasts for DMs, group DMs, friends and chosen servers, placed in a corner with a timeout, instead of OS notifications. Carry over position, timeout, opacity, maxNotifications, disableInStreamerMode, respectDoNotDisturb, directMessages, groupMessages, friendServerNotifications, ignoreUsers, notifyFor. gravecord has desktop notifications (notifications.rs, notifications/windows.rs), so this is a separate in-window card layer. Needs base: a toast layer in the window.

A key combo toggles your camera in a call. Carry over keyBind, reqCtrl, reqShift, reqAlt. gravecord has a keybinds page (settings/keybinds.rs); add camera toggle as a plugin keybind action calling the existing camera on/off.

Tone tags like /srs and /gen in messages get a hover tooltip with their meaning. Carry over prefix and customIndicators. Hooks the markdown text renderer for the tag tokens and the existing tooltip (tooltip.rs).

Message menu and hover button translate with Google, DeepL or Kagi, an auto-translate toggle, and a composer button that translates before sending. gravecord's Translate+ already does Google for received messages (plugins/translate_plus.rs); this adds the sent-side composer button, DeepL and Kagi with key settings (service, deeplApiKey, receivedInput, receivedOutput, sentInput, sentOutput, autoTranslate, showChatBarButton). Best done by extending Translate+.

Message menu entry Answer With AI sends the message text (and optionally images) to an AI API with the user's own key and shows the answer as a local note under the message. Keep it off by default; needs an API key setting and a local-only message annotation.
Trims shared leading indentation from code blocks in messages and when sending. A text transform in the code block renderer (code_copy.rs area) and the send transform.
Message hover button converts units mentioned in the text to the user's units. Carry over myUnits. A text parser plus a local note under the message.

Lets @name autocomplete find users from any server (or only DM contacts), inserting a mention. Carry over globalMention, onlyDMUsers. Hooks the autocomplete source (ui/autocomplete.rs); whether the mention notifies a non-member is up to the server, so only the lookup is certain.

Shows the numeric unread count on channels in the list, including muted ones, up to a limit. Carry over showOnMutedChannels, notificationCountLimit. Hooks the channel row badge in the server channel list.

Message menu entry removes the suppress-embeds flag so link embeds show again on your own messages (or where you can manage messages). A message flags edit through the existing message API; menu entry in context_menu.rs.
Highlights URLs matching glob patterns in message text and embeds in a chosen style. Carry over patterns, boldUrls, highlightEmbeds. Hooks link rendering in the markdown text.
Installs Equicord userplugins (git-cloned JS source) from a channel button; gravecord plugins are compiled in Rust, so there is nothing to install or update at runtime.

A small voice icon next to a user in the member list, DM list, profile name and message headers when they are in a voice channel; hover shows the channel name and click joins. Carry over showInUserProfileModal, showInMemberList, showInMessages. Voice state of other users is already in the app state (voice.rs).

Speaks voice channel joins, leaves and moves aloud with text-to-speech. Carry over voice, volume, rate, sayOwnName, latinOnly and the join/leave/move/mute/unmute/deafen/undeafen message templates. Needs base: an OS text-to-speech call (Windows speech API through the native layer); none was found in app/src.

Puts output and input volume sliders and device selectors (optionally camera) in the voice panel as a collapsible block so the settings page is not needed. Carry over uncollapseSettingsByDefault, outputVolume, inputVolume, outputDevice, inputDevice, camera and the show*Header keys. Uses the existing audio menu and volume controls (audio_menu.rs, settings/voice/extra.rs).
Fixes for the Vesktop and Equibop Electron shells (title bar, Wayland, tray); gravecord is not those shells.

Message menu and hover button show a message's raw JSON (and copy it) from the cached gateway data, with sensitive fields optionally stripped. Carry over clickMethod, messageContextMenu, sortKeys, stripSensitiveData. Needs base: a modal that shows long monospace text and keeping the raw JSON of loaded messages (no existing view-raw surface found in app/src).

Chat, mute and deafen buttons next to each person in the voice panel so you do not open the menu. Carry over showChatButton, showMuteButton, showDeafenButton, buttonPosition. Uses the existing local mute and deafen of a user (call_menus.rs) and opens the DM.

A log of who joined, left, moved, muted, turned camera or screenshare on, and used the soundboard in voice channels you can see, opened from a header bar button or the plugin menu. Carry over the plugin's history and event filter keys; stored in the local data store. Voice state events already arrive; needs base: a log modal.

A single click on a voice channel selects it and a double click joins, so an accidental click does not drop you into a call. No settings. Hooks the voice channel row click in the channel list (ui/voice.rs).

Voice channel menu items to move, disconnect or mute everyone in the channel, or pull everyone to yours, for people with the permissions, paced by a rate-limit wait. Carry over waitAfter, waitSeconds. Uses the member move and mute calls in voice.rs.

Sends a notice in your DM with a friend when they join a voice channel (local notice, not a real message), optionally with members and counts. Carry over friendDirectMessages, friendDirectMessagesShowMembers, friendDirectMessagesShowMemberCount, friendDirectMessagesSelf, friendDirectMessagesSilent, allowedFriends, ignoredFriends, ignoreBlockedUsers. A local notice in the DM view or a desktop notification.

A voice message keeps playing when you switch channels, controlled by a mini player in the header bar. gravecord has audio attachment players (ui/audio_attachment.rs) and a video PiP (ui/video_pip.rs); keep the voice message player alive across channel changes with a small header control. No settings.

If you are disconnected from a voice channel by the server, rejoins after a delay unless the call has ended. Carry over rejoinDelay, rejoinTimeout, preventReconnectIfCallEnded, applyOnlyToDms. Hooks the voice disconnect event in voice.rs.

When a voice channel is full, offers to wait and joins as soon as a slot opens (optionally automatically, with a sound). Carry over autoJoin, notificationSound. gravecord already shows the full-channel alert (voice_alerts.rs voice_channel_full); the waiting watcher is new.
A developer tool that exports Discord webpack modules as a tarball for mod authors; gravecord has no webpack.
Makes the Discord web app installable as a PWA; gravecord is already a native installed app.
gravecord detects games and takes local RPC activity itself (ui/running_games.rs, dc_rpc), which is what this plugin adds to Discord Web through arRPC.

gravecord's own Go Live flow (ui/go_live.rs) offers the resolution, frame rate and audio choices the plugin adds to the browser's screen share; the content hint is a browser WebRTC flag with no counterpart.

Hides all default Unicode emojis from the picker and autocomplete except ones you whitelist, with import, export and reset. Carry over defaultEmojis, serverEmojis, disableToasts, whiteListedEmojis. Hooks the emoji picker and autocomplete data.
